title: Does not last longer than a year before needing replacement battery - Poor customer service
text: Does not last longer than a year before needing replacement battery - Poor customer service. I was so excited when I bought my Dyson and LOVED it for the first 13 months.  So much so that I even bought my mom an identical one hoping it would work great for her as well.  Well, now 13 months later I can get it to run about 45 seconds on MAX setting before it dies (used to get about 15-20 minutes out of it). Talked to customer service and followed all their instructions (clean filters, use compressed air to blow out tiny holes in the middle of the metal part of the unit), still nothing helped.  Contacted them again and was told by Dyson to buy a new battery for it on their website at $120, or purchase a new unit at a slightly discounted price!!!! Yeah, okay, I don't think so.  I actually ordered a replacement battery on Amazon for about $50, so we will see how that goes, as I haven't received it yet. At this point, not sure I would buy Dyson again though. A product should not have a life span of 1 year before having to spend money to get it working again.  Poor product design!
